svg.aria-label: A length-scale ladder for dense detection and classification in materials electron microscopy. From about 0.1 nanometres to 10 micrometres, four rungs: atomic columns and point defects detected by fully convolutional heatmaps and classified with metadata-conditioned networks; extended defects and nanoparticles such as dislocation loops, cavities and supported particles detected with YOLO11 or Mask R-CNN and augmented with mask-conditioned diffusion; diffraction-space classes read per pixel from 4D-STEM for polarization, phase and orientation; and microstructure at the SEM scale segmented by foundation models, EM3M-trained instance segmenters and MLLM-prompted SAM. A band across all rungs shows the cross-cutting layer: simulation-to-real transfer, self-supervised and metadata-conditioned pretraining, performance prediction without labels, and agentic or autonomous microscopes that choose where to look next.
svg.title: Materials EM dense detection by length scale: atoms, defects and particles, diffraction classes, microstructure
svg.text: What counts as an "object" depends on the rung: four detection problems, five decades of length
4 · Microstructure (SEM / low-mag TEM): grains, precipitates, pores, particles by the thousand
EM3M: 5,091 micrographs, ~3M instance masks — detection- and query-based segmenters struggle at extreme density; flow-based baseline
SEM MoE-MAE foundation model • EMSeek reference-guided one-for-all segmentation • MLLM (Qwen3-VL + LoRA) → point prompts → frozen SAM
3 · Diffraction-space classes (4D-STEM): the class of a pixel is read from its diffraction pattern
Polarization direction (CNN domain mapping; ResNet/VGG/PCA-kNN benchmark — the sim→experiment gap dominates) • phase/orientation/strain
Unsupervised contour clustering in py4DSTEM (4D & 5D, CPU) • learned ptychography: PtyRANNOSAUR, zero-shot cross-material phase
2 · Extended defects & nanoparticles: dislocation lines/loops, cavities, supported and liquid-cell particles
YOLO11 transfer learning segments lines + loops on unseen alloys • Mask R-CNN + mask-conditioned latent diffusion (10/50/100 real images)
YOLO + Mobile-UNet at ~102 FPS in liquid-cell TEM • random-forest F1 predictor (MAE 0.09, R² 0.77) flags when not to trust the detector
1 · Atomic columns & point defects (HAADF / ABF-STEM, HRTEM)
FCN heatmaps → column positions (benchmarks: strong in-distribution, weak at interfaces) • CycleGAN + U-Net from a single image (MoS₂)
Context-aware classifier: pixels + composition, kV, detector angles; ~55M simulated patches, 96 doped TMDs, >98% sim, near-human on real
CrSBr defect library (PRX 2025): "single vacancies" turn out to be complexes • AtomDiffuser separates drift and beam damage
Simulate-to-train (multislice / Bloch-wave) and close the sim→real gap • CIMP: CLIP-style image ↔ 7-D acquisition-metadata pretraining (7,330 pairs)
Label-free reliability estimates • MLLMs still far below experts on characterization (MatCha, 1,500 Qs / 21 tasks)
Closed loop: detections steer the next scan — novelty-driven / Pareto acquisition (PATHFINDER), agentic analysis in 2–5 min per image (EMSeek)
